stage.note: an enhancement STAGE for video only: 4x streaming super-resolution of another stage's clip; no prompt; no core nodes - every recipe needs a pack

cannot.what: run on core ComfyUI: no FlashVSR module in comfy_extras (master listing 2026-10-01); the only Comfy-Org template is a paid WaveSpeed API node (excluded). All local use is a community pack
scales other than 4x without 'reduced stability': 'primarily designed and optimized for 4x video super-resolution. We strongly recommend using the 4x SR setting'
take a text prompt: all wrappers use a fixed positive embedding (posi_prompt.pth / Prompt.safetensors)
stills or very short clips: the 1038lab pack requires >= 21 frames 'for initialization'; short inputs fail or duplicate frames

guaranteed acceleration on RTX 40/50: the official Block-Sparse Attention is verified only on A100/A800 (H200 limited, 'RTX 40/50 series or H800 ... currently unknown'); the wrappers substitute Sparse_SageAttention (sm_75-sm_120)
quality without sparse attention: 'Some third-party implementations (early ComfyUI versions) omit sparse attention, causing quality degradation', 'especially at higher resolutions'

comfyui.nodes_read_from: pack sources: lihaoyun6 nodes.py, LacklusterOpsec nodes.py + CHANGELOG, 1038lab AILab_FlashVSR.py (fetched 2026-10-01); no FlashVSR class exists in the v0.35.0 registry
comfyui.nodes_verified_against_registry: only the native spine (LoadVideo, GetVideoComponents, CreateVideo, SaveVideo) - verified 2026-10-01; the pack classes are flagged unknown by the offline validator, by design
comfyui.note: Phase 2 must install exactly one of the Lackluster / lihaoyun6 packs (identical class ids) and re-read /object_info before the recipe is submitted.

community_alternatives.what: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR (GPL-3.0; Manager: comfy node install ComfyUI-FlashVSR): nodes AILab_FlashVSR ('FlashVSR', presets Fast (2x Speed) / Balanced (2x Quality) [default] / Long Video (Low VRAM) / High Quality (Best) = Full model; scale 2-4 step 2) and AILab_FlashVSR_Advanced (model_version Tiny/Tiny Long/Full, enable_tiling, tile_size 384 (128-1024, 'Recommended: 384-512 for HD'), tile_overlap 24 ('Recommended: 48-64 ... Must be < Tile Size / 2'), speed_optimization 2.0 = sparse ratio, quality_boost 2.0 = kv ratio ('Full can handle 3.0'), stability_level 11 = local_range, color_fix, vae_tiling, sageattention, precision bf16|fp16, seed). Independent class ids - can coexist with one of the other packs. Minimum 21 frames.

selection.why: Lackluster fork (maintained: 1.5.1 on 2026-08-26, MIT, registry-listed), 24 GB+ row: full mode (Wan VAE decode), bf16, no tiling/chunking - best quality the pack documents
the pack's 16 GB row: tiny mode, tiled VAE+DiT, unload_dit, 50-frame chunks; ports carry the 12 GB (fp16, LightVAE_W2.1) and 8 GB (tiny-long, LightTAE_HY1.5, chunks 16-32) rows
selection.tradeoff: TCDecoder decode instead of the Wan VAE; slower from tiling

selection.why: the lihaoyun6 original (GPL-3.0): same node ids and knobs, fewer options (no fp8, no chunking, no alt VAE catalogue); pick it only if the Lackluster fork is unavailable
selection.tradeoff: GPL-3.0; no frame_chunk_size - long clips need tiny-long mode

selection.status: pending: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR documented under community_alternatives only (presets over the same tiny/tiny-long/full modes; the Advanced node's `device` options are NOT FOUND)

params.name: scale
params.interactions: official: 4x is the trained setting, other scales 'may show reduced stability'; lihaoyun6 README: '4 is always better, unless you are low on VRAM then use 2'

params.name: mode
params.meaning: tiny = TCDecoder decode (fast, less VRAM); tiny-long = streaming for long inputs ('significantly reduce VRAM'); full = Wan VAE decode (higher quality)
params.interactions: alt_vae (lihaoyun6) applies only in full mode; 1038lab presets map onto the same three

params.name: vae_model / alt_vae
params.meaning: the decode VAE in full mode
params.interactions: LightVAE_W2.1 '50% less VRAM' (12 GB row); LightTAE_HY1.5 (8 GB row); auto-downloaded from lightx2v/Autoencoders

params.name: precision
params.meaning: compute dtype of the fp32-stored DiT

defaults.rows: bf16 at 16-24 GB, fp16 at 8-12 GB

params.interactions: fp8_e4m3fn (Lackluster only) 'cuts VRAM in half (requires PyTorch 2.1+ and Ada/Hopper GPU)'

params.name: attention_mode
params.interactions: the model's Locality-Constrained Sparse Attention is what the official warning is about: dense backends (sdpa / flash_attention_2) drop it -> quality loss at high resolution; Block-Sparse is the official backend, verified A100/A800 only; Sparse_Sage covers RTX 20-50; Turing needs triton<3.3.0

params.name: tiled_vae / tiled_dit / tile_size / tile_overlap
params.meaning: VAE and DiT tiling of the input video
params.interactions: 'Significantly reduces VRAM usage at the cost of speed'; 1038lab: overlap 'Must be < Tile Size / 2', tile 384-512 for HD

params.name: frame_chunk_size
params.meaning: Lackluster only: process the clip in chunks of N frames 'to prevent VRAM OOM'
params.interactions: 0 = all frames; lihaoyun6 has no chunking (use tiny-long mode)

params.name: unload_dit
params.meaning: 'Unload DiT before decoding to reduce VRAM peak at the cost of speed'

params.name: sparse_ratio / kv_ratio / local_range
params.interactions: sparse_ratio 1.5 faster / 2.0 more stable; kv_ratio 1.0 less VRAM / 3.0 high quality; local_range 9 sharper / 11 more stable (temporally)

params.name: color_fix
params.meaning: 'Use wavelet transform to correct output video color'
params.interactions: keep on in every pack (pitfall: colour shift)

params.name: input length
params.interactions: long clips: Lackluster frame_chunk_size, 1038lab 'Tiny Long', lihaoyun6 'tiny-long'; a community report hit OOM on a 32 GB 5090 beyond ~100 frames during decode

rules.message: FlashVSR is a streaming model that needs >= 21 input frames to initialise (1038lab: 'Requires at least 21 frames for initialization'; shorter inputs fail or duplicate frames); the other packs state no minimum (NOT FOUND) - never feed it a still
scale is 2-4 in every wrapper

official: 'primarily designed and optimized for 4x ... We strongly recommend using the 4x SR setting'; other scales 'may show reduced stability'. 2x is a VRAM concession only - if the target is 2x, upscale 4x and resize down
mode is tiny (TCDecoder), tiny-long (streaming, low VRAM) or full (Wan VAE decode)
alt_vae 'Replaces the built-in VAE, only available in full mode' - in tiny modes the TCDecoder decodes and the setting is ignored

Block-Sparse Attention (the official backend) 'works correctly on NVIDIA A100 and A800 (Ampere) with ideal acceleration', 'runs correctly on H200 (Hopper) but the acceleration is limited', 'RTX 40/50 series or H800 are currently unknown'; its compile 'is memory-intensive'; the wrapper limits it to sm_80-sm_100. On consumer cards use sparse_sage_attention (sm_75-sm_120)

a dense backend omits the Locality-Constrained Sparse Attention: official warning of 'noticeable quality degradation, especially at higher resolutions'. Keep sparse_sage_attention (or block_sparse_attention on A100/A800)
fp8_e4m3fn 'cuts VRAM in half (requires PyTorch 2.1+ and Ada/Hopper GPU)' - not for Ampere or older
tile_size is 32-1024 in steps of 32 (node definition)
tile_overlap is 8-512 in steps of 8 (node definition)
tile overlap 'Must be < Tile Size / 2' (1038lab); recommended 48-64 on 384-512 tiles for HD

tiling off is the 24 GB+ row (full mode, no chunking); on 16 GB and below the pack's table has tiled VAE + tiled DiT on, unload_dit on and frame chunks (50-100 at 16 GB, 50 at 12 GB, 16-32 at 8 GB) - the progressive fallback is tiled VAE -> tiled DiT -> chunking
sparse_ratio 1.5 (faster) to 2.0 (more stable)
kv_ratio 1.0 (less VRAM) to 3.0 (high quality)
local_range is 9 (sharper details) or 11 (more stable results)
keep color_fix True (wavelet colour transfer) in every pack, or the output drifts in colour from the source
v1.1 (November 2025) is the current release: 'enhanced stability + fidelity', 'avoids texture aliasing and visual artifacts'; v1 also carries the aspect-ratio-switch artifact fixed 2025-10-21
FlashVSR upscales frames one-for-one: CreateVideo.fps must be wired from GetVideoComponents (as audio is), or the clip changes speed
the Lackluster fork and the lihaoyun6 original register the same class ids: installing both collides at registration - install exactly one
NOT FOUND: neither pack states a ComfyUI minimum; the native spine nodes exist in v0.35.0

prompting.note: not applicable: no user prompt. Every wrapper uses a fixed positive prompt embedding shipped with the pack (posi_prompt.pth in lihaoyun6/Lackluster; Prompt.safetensors in the 1038lab repack).

pitfalls.symptom: soft / degraded output at high resolution
pitfalls.cause: a wrapper or backend without sparse attention (official warning)
pitfalls.fix: attention_mode sparse_sage_attention (or block_sparse_attention on A100/A800), never sdpa / flash_attention_2 for quality parity

pitfalls.symptom: Triton / attention build fails on Turing or older

pitfalls.cause: full mode at 4x, long clip, no tiling
pitfalls.fix: tiled_vae -> tiled_dit -> frame_chunk_size (Lackluster) / tiny-long mode; unload_dit; LightVAE / LightTAE; fp8 on Ada/Hopper; a 32 GB 5090 reportedly OOMs beyond ~100 frames in decode without chunking

pitfalls.symptom: fails or duplicates frames on a short input
pitfalls.fix: feed >= 21 frames; 1038lab fixed a frame-duplication bug on 2025-11-15

pitfalls.symptom: 'FlashVSR streaming pipeline produced no output frames'
pitfalls.fix: update the fork (1.5.1 fixed the loop and the KV-cache init)

pitfalls.symptom: nodes missing or duplicated after install
pitfalls.cause: both Lackluster and lihaoyun6 installed (same class ids)

pitfalls.symptom: artifacts when aspect ratio changes between clips

pitfalls.cause: scale 2 is a VRAM concession, not the trained setting
pitfalls.fix: scale 4 then resize down (ImageScaleBy 0.5) when VRAM allows
delete the models/FlashVSR folder and restart ComfyUI to re-download; SageAttention conflicts: pip uninstall sageattention triton
